categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Modifies BaseIndex and all index implementations in `src/index/` to batch LevelDB writes and reduce cs_main locking during initial sync.
categories.rationale: Optimizes index synchronization by batching LevelDB writes up to 500 blocks and acquiring block ranges under a single cs_main acquisition. The PR description notes this 'improves sync time on HDD due to the reduced number of disk write operations' and reduces cs_main contention slowing concurrent block validation. Correctness and crash safety during batch sync boundaries are primary review concerns raised in the discussion.
